title: Legal Discovery Document Analysis
business: Legal firms managing massive litigation discovery datasets.
problem: Manual review of multi-million token document sets leads to missed evidence and prohibitive labor costs.
solution: Utilizing Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 with its 1M token context window and Dual Chunk Attention to ingest entire case files for automated retrieval and summarization.
steps: Configure the model environment with the 1M token config_1m.json file.
Deploy the model using vLLM with VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=DUAL_CHUNK_FLASH_ATTN to handle long-context memory requirements.
Integrate the Qwen-Agent framework to define custom retrieval tools for specific legal document types.
Execute batch processing of discovery documents using chunked prefill to maintain system stability.
outcome: Legal teams achieve rapid identification of relevant case facts across vast document archives without manual triage.
limitation: The 1M token context requires approximately 1000 GB of GPU memory; check for OOM errors by monitoring KV cache utilization or reducing max_num_batched_tokens.

code.content:
from qwen_agent.agents import Assistant
# Define LLM with custom endpoint
llm_cfg = {'model': 'Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507', 'model_server': 'http://localhost:8000/v1'}
# Define tools for document retrieval
tools = ['code_interpreter']
bot = Assistant(llm=llm_cfg, function_list=tools)
# Run analysis on long-context input
messages = [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Analyze these 500k tokens of discovery...'}]
for responses in bot.run(messages=messages): pass
